userStories.title: Failure-mode hardening + idempotency for finalizeCycleClose
userStories.description: As an operator, I need finalizeCycleClose to fail loudly on real problems (issue not in issues.local.json) and silently no-op on benign repeats (already-finalized cycle), so a transient failure or a re-run does not corrupt state.
acceptanceCriteria: When issue_system == 'none' and the matching issue-id is NOT in issues.local.json, finalizeCycleClose returns a non-zero exit code with a clear error message (printError) that names the missing id; the rm + commit do NOT proceed silently. [oracle: bun test test/ship-finalize-hardening.test.ts]

When scripts/cam/prd.json is absent entirely AND no harness files exist, finalizeCycleClose exits cleanly (idempotent no-op, exit 0, no commit) and logs a muted hint. [oracle: bun test test/ship-finalize-hardening.test.ts]

When the rm produces no staged changes (nothing was tracked), the commit step is skipped cleanly (no `nothing to commit` git error surfaces as a failure); exit 0. [oracle: bun test test/ship-finalize-hardening.test.ts]
A second invocation immediately after a successful first run is a clean no-op (exit 0, no duplicate commit). [oracle: bun test test/ship-finalize-hardening.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: New test file: test/ship-finalize-hardening.test.ts (or extend test/ship-finalize.test.ts). Use injected fakes from US-001's surface. Idempotency matters because CAM-71 auto-ship may re-invoke if a downstream step fails. The 'nothing to commit' guard can be implemented by checking `git diff --cached --quiet` before commit (exit 0 = no staged changes). Keep error messages aligned with src/logging/color.ts printError style.

userStories.notes: Use src/logging/screen.ts emit helpers (emitTitle/emitSectionHeading/emitOk) and src/logging/color.ts printError. The commit sha can be obtained via `git rev-parse --short HEAD` after commit (one more spawnFn call). Keep the result line plain text + readable; this is not JSON. CAM-71 auto-ship narrative depends on this being present and stable, so do not change the shape after release without bumping a test.
